#Start event from estate
country_event = {
	id = cosmo_eurowivesestate_events.10
	title = cosmo_eurowivesestate_events.10.t
	desc = cosmo_eurowivesestate_events.10.d
	picture = cosmogfx_WIVES_EUROPE_MENU_6B_1_eventPicture

	hidden = yes

	trigger = {
		ai = no
		NOT = {
		has_ruler_flag = visiting_concubines
	}
	has_ruler_flag = cosmo_wives_launch
			OR = {
				culture_group = germanic		
				culture_group = scandinavian		
				culture_group = british		
				culture_group = gaelic
				culture_group = latin
				culture_group = iberian		
				culture_group = french	
				culture_group = carpathian		
				culture_group = south_slavic		
				culture_group = west_slavic			
				culture_group = east_slavic		
				culture_group = baltic		
				culture_group = byzantine		
				culture_group = caucasian
			}		
		}

		mean_time_to_happen = {
			days = 1
		}

	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
		set_ruler_flag = visiting_concubines
		clr_ruler_flag = cosmo_wives_launch
		remove_estate_privilege= estate_wives_ruler_visit
		if = {
			limit = {
			has_ruler_flag = ruler_visit_concubines
			}
			random_list = {
				33 = { #adm
						set_ruler_flag = ruler_palace_adm
				}
				33 = { #dip
						set_ruler_flag = ruler_palace_dip
	
				}
				33 = { #mil
						set_ruler_flag = ruler_palace_mil
	
				}																				
			}
		}		
		}
		}	
	
	option = {
		name = cosmo_eurowivesestate_events.10.a	
		if = {
			limit = {
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = cosmo_concubines_in_capital #china
				has_country_flag = cosmo_pirate_in_capital
				has_country_flag = cosmo_euroharem_in_capital
				has_country_flag = comso_ooku_in_capital
				has_country_flag = cosmo_africawives_in_capital
				has_country_flag = cosmo_purconcubines_in_capital
				has_country_flag = cosmo_menaharem_in_capital
				has_country_flag = cosmo_sawives_in_capital
				has_country_flag = cosmo_nawives_in_capital
				has_country_flag = cosmo_indiaharem_in_capital
			}
		OR = {
			has_ruler_flag = ruler_visit_concubines
			has_ruler_flag = ruler_mandate_concubines
		}		
		}
			country_event = {
			id = cosmo_eurowivesestate_events.30
			}
		}		
		if = {
			limit = {
			NOT = {
				has_country_flag = cosmo_concubines_in_capital #china
				has_country_flag = cosmo_pirate_in_capital
				has_country_flag = cosmo_euroharem_in_capital
				has_country_flag = comso_ooku_in_capital
				has_country_flag = cosmo_africawives_in_capital
				has_country_flag = cosmo_purconcubines_in_capital
				has_country_flag = cosmo_menaharem_in_capital
				has_country_flag = cosmo_sawives_in_capital
				has_country_flag = cosmo_nawives_in_capital
				has_country_flag = cosmo_indiaharem_in_capital
			}	
		OR = {
			has_ruler_flag = ruler_visit_concubines
			has_ruler_flag = ruler_mandate_concubines
		}		
		}
			country_event = {
			id = cosmo_eurowivesestate_events.10100
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
		OR = {
			has_ruler_flag = ruler_isolation_concubines
		}		
		}
			country_event = {
			id = cosmo_eurowivesestate_events.20
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
		OR = {
			has_ruler_flag = ruler_advisors_concubines
		}		
		}
			country_event = {
			id = cosmo_onsenaffairs_events.401
			}
		}		
		if = {
			limit = {
		OR = {
			has_ruler_flag = ruler_renovate_concubines
		}		
		}
			country_event = {
			id = cosmo_eurowivesestate_events.1
			}
		}																										
	}

#grant wives 1a
country_event = {
	id = cosmo_eurowivesestate_events.11
	title = cosmo_eurowivesestate_events.11.t
	desc = cosmo_eurowivesestate_events.11.d
	picture = cosmogfx_WIVES_EUROPE_MENU_1A_1_eventPicture
	goto = consortprovince

	is_triggered_only = yes

	trigger = {
		ai = no
		OR = {
			has_estate = estate_forbiddenpalace 
			has_estate = estate_harem 
			has_estate = estate_ooku 
			has_estate = estate_wives 
			has_estate = estate_nobleaffairs
			has_estate = estate_harem 
		}
		NOT = {
		any_province = {
			country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
				has_province_modifier = eurow_concubine_1a
		}
		}
		
		OR = {
			development_in_provinces = {
				value = 3
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
			OR = {
				culture = highland_scottish
			}
			}
			any_subject_country = {
			development_in_provinces = {
				value = 3
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
			OR = {
				culture = highland_scottish
			}
			}				
			}			
				OR = {
				primary_culture = highland_scottish
				}
		}
			
	}



	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
		every_province = {
			limit = {
				has_province_modifier = eurow_concubine_1a
			}
			remove_province_modifier = eurow_concubine_1a
		}
		set_country_flag = cosmo_eurowives_in_capital
		random_province = {
			limit = {
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
				culture = highland_scottish
			}
				save_event_target_as = consortprovince
		}
		random_province = {
			limit = {
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
				culture = highland_scottish
				development = 9
			}
				save_event_target_as = consortprovince
		}
		random_province = {
			limit = {
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
				culture = highland_scottish
				development = 15
			}
				save_event_target_as = consortprovince
		}
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_forbiddenpalace
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_harem
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_ooku
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}		
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_nobleaffairs
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_wives
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}		
			event_target:consortprovince = {
			add_province_modifier = { 
				name = cosmo_has_consort_present
				duration =  -1
				hidden = yes
				}				
			add_province_modifier = { 
				name = cosmo_has_consort_present
				duration =  -1
				hidden = yes
				}				
			add_province_modifier = { 
				name = eurow_concubine_1a
				duration =  -1
				desc = eurow_concubine_1a_DESC
				}			
			}																													
		}
	}	
	
	option = {
		name = cosmo_eurowivesestate_events.11.a
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				has_estate = estate_nobleaffairs
			}
			NOT = {
				any_subject_country = {
				OR = {
				primary_culture = highland_scottish
				}
					cosmo_asian_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
			event_target:consortprovince = {
				owned_by = ROOT		
			}
		}	
		event_target:consortprovince = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = "domain_of_spouses_family"
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
			event_target:consortprovince = {
			NOT = {
				owned_by = ROOT		
			}	
			}
		}	
		#set_ruler_flag = has_lowborn_consort
		}					
		define_consort = {
			culture = highland_scottish
		}
		set_consort_flag = cosmo_consort
		set_consort_flag = cosmo_eurowives_1a								
		country_event = { 
			id = cosmo_eumarriage_events.101
			}
		tooltip = {
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_forbiddenpalace
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_harem
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_ooku
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}		
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_nobleaffairs
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_wives
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}
		}					
		}
		option = {
		name = cosmo_eurowivesestate_events.11.b
		tooltip = {
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_forbiddenpalace
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_harem
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_ooku
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}		
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_nobleaffairs
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_wives

country_event = {
	id = cosmo_eurowivesestate_events.13
	title = cosmo_eurowivesestate_events.13.t
	desc = cosmo_eurowivesestate_events.13.d
	picture = cosmogfx_WIVES_EUROPE_MENU_1C_1_eventPicture
	goto = consortprovince

	is_triggered_only = yes

	trigger = {
		ai = no
		OR = {
			has_estate = estate_forbiddenpalace 
			has_estate = estate_harem 
			has_estate = estate_ooku 
			has_estate = estate_wives 
			has_estate = estate_nobleaffairs
			has_estate = estate_harem 
		}
		NOT = {
		any_province = {
			country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
				has_province_modifier = eurow_concubine_1c
		}
		}
		
		OR = {
			development_in_provinces = {
				value = 20
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
			OR = {
				culture = scottish
			}
			}
			any_subject_country = {
			development_in_provinces = {
				value = 20
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
			OR = {
				culture = scottish
			}
			}				
			}			
				OR = {
				primary_culture = scottish
				}
		}
			
	}



	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
		every_province = {
			limit = {
				has_province_modifier = eurow_concubine_1c
			}
			remove_province_modifier = eurow_concubine_1c
		}
		set_country_flag = cosmo_eurowives_in_capital
		random_province = {
			limit = {
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
				culture = scottish
			}
				save_event_target_as = consortprovince
		}
		random_province = {
			limit = {
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
				culture = scottish
				development = 9
			}
				save_event_target_as = consortprovince
		}
		random_province = {
			limit = {
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
				culture = scottish
				development = 15
			}
				save_event_target_as = consortprovince
		}
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_forbiddenpalace
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_harem
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_ooku
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}		
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_nobleaffairs
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_wives
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}		
			event_target:consortprovince = {
			add_province_modifier = { 
				name = cosmo_has_consort_present
				duration =  -1
				hidden = yes
				}				
			add_province_modifier = { 
				name = eurow_concubine_1c
				duration =  -1
				desc = eurow_concubine_1c_DESC
				}			
			}																													
		}
	}

			}
		}

			add_province_modifier = {
				name = "domain_of_spouses_family"
				duration = -1
			}
		}

		ai = no
		OR = {
			has_estate = estate_forbiddenpalace 
			has_estate = estate_harem 
			has_estate = estate_ooku 
			has_estate = estate_wives 
			has_estate = estate_nobleaffairs
			has_estate = estate_harem 
		}

			development_in_provinces = {

				value = 3

				has_province_modifier = eurow_concubine_4a

		}

			limit = {
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT

				development = 15
			}
				save_event_target_as = consortprovince
		}

#grant wives 5a
country_event = {
	id = cosmo_eurowivesestate_events.51
	title = cosmo_eurowivesestate_events.51.t
	desc = cosmo_eurowivesestate_events.51.d
	picture = cosmogfx_WIVES_EUROPE_MENU_5A_1_eventPicture
	goto = consortprovince

	is_triggered_only = yes

	trigger = {
		ai = no
		OR = {
			has_estate = estate_forbiddenpalace 
			has_estate = estate_harem 
			has_estate = estate_ooku 
			has_estate = estate_wives 
			has_estate = estate_nobleaffairs
			has_estate = estate_harem 
		}
		NOT = {
		any_province = {
			country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
				has_province_modifier = eurow_concubine_5a
		}
		}
		
		OR = {
			development_in_provinces = {
				value = 3
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
			OR = {
				culture = dutch
			}
			}
			any_subject_country = {
			development_in_provinces = {
				value = 3
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
			OR = {
				culture = dutch
			}
			}				
			}			
				OR = {
				primary_culture = dutch
				}
		}
			
	}



	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
		every_province = {
			limit = {
				has_province_modifier = eurow_concubine_5a
			}
			remove_province_modifier = eurow_concubine_5a
		}
		set_country_flag = cosmo_eurowives_in_capital
		random_province = {
			limit = {
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
				culture = dutch
			}
				save_event_target_as = consortprovince
		}
		random_province = {
			limit = {
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
				culture = dutch
				development = 9
			}
				save_event_target_as = consortprovince
		}
		random_province = {
			limit = {
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
				culture = dutch
				development = 15
			}
				save_event_target_as = consortprovince
		}
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_forbiddenpalace
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_harem
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_ooku
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}		
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_nobleaffairs
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_wives
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}		
			event_target:consortprovince = {
			add_province_modifier = { 
				name = cosmo_has_consort_present
				duration =  -1
				hidden = yes
				}				
			add_province_modifier = { 
				name = eurow_concubine_5a
				duration =  -1
				desc = eurow_concubine_5a_DESC
				}			
			}																													
		}
	}

					cosmo_asian_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes
				}

			add_province_modifier = {

				value = 3
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT

			}

		}

				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT

				development = 15
			}
				save_event_target_as = consortprovince

			has_estate = estate_wives 
			has_estate = estate_nobleaffairs
			has_estate = estate_harem 
		}
		NOT = {
		any_province = {
			country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
				has_province_modifier = eurow_concubine_9b
		}
		}
		
		OR = {
			development_in_provinces = {
				value = 3
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
			OR = {
				culture = burgundian
			}
			}
			any_subject_country = {
			development_in_provinces = {
				value = 3
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
			OR = {
				culture = burgundian
			}
			}				
			}			
				OR = {
				primary_culture = burgundian
				}
		}
			
	}

				has_province_modifier = eurow_concubine_9b
			}

			limit = {
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT

				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT

			}
				save_event_target_as = consortprovince
		}

			limit = {
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
				culture = burgundian
				development = 15
			}
				save_event_target_as = consortprovince

country_event = {

	title = cosmo_eurowivesestate_events.1013.t
	desc = cosmo_eurowivesestate_events.1013.d
	picture = cosmogfx_WIVES_EUROPE_MENU_11C_1_eventPicture
	goto = consortprovince

	is_triggered_only = yes

	trigger = {
		ai = no
		OR = {
			has_estate = estate_forbiddenpalace 
			has_estate = estate_harem 
			has_estate = estate_ooku 
			has_estate = estate_wives 
			has_estate = estate_nobleaffairs
			has_estate = estate_harem 
		}
		NOT = {
		any_province = {
			country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
				has_province_modifier = eurow_concubine_11c
		}
		}
		
		OR = {
			development_in_provinces = {
				value = 3
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
			OR = {
				culture = piedmontese
			}
			}
			any_subject_country = {
			development_in_provinces = {
				value = 3
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
			OR = {
				culture = piedmontese
			}
			}				
			}			
				OR = {
				primary_culture = piedmontese
				}
		}
			
	}

		every_province = {
			limit = {
				has_province_modifier = eurow_concubine_11c
			}
			remove_province_modifier = eurow_concubine_11c
		}
		set_country_flag = cosmo_eurowives_in_capital

			limit = {
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
				culture = piedmontese
			}
				save_event_target_as = consortprovince
		}

			limit = {
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
				culture = piedmontese
				development = 9
			}
				save_event_target_as = consortprovince
		}
		random_province = {
			limit = {
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
				culture = piedmontese
				development = 15
			}
				save_event_target_as = consortprovince
		}
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_forbiddenpalace

#grant wives 12c
country_event = {
	id = cosmo_eurowivesestate_events.1023
	title = cosmo_eurowivesestate_events.1023.t
	desc = cosmo_eurowivesestate_events.1023.d
	picture = cosmogfx_WIVES_EUROPE_MENU_12C_1_eventPicture
	goto = consortprovince

	is_triggered_only = yes

	trigger = {
		ai = no
		OR = {
			has_estate = estate_forbiddenpalace 
			has_estate = estate_harem 
			has_estate = estate_ooku 
			has_estate = estate_wives 
			has_estate = estate_nobleaffairs
			has_estate = estate_harem 
		}
		NOT = {
		any_province = {
			country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
				has_province_modifier = eurow_concubine_12c
		}
		}
		
		OR = {
			development_in_provinces = {
				value = 3
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
			OR = {
				culture = venetian
			}
			}
			any_subject_country = {
			development_in_provinces = {
				value = 3
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
			OR = {
				culture = venetian
			}
			}				
			}			
				OR = {
				primary_culture = venetian
				}
		}
			
	}



	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
		every_province = {
			limit = {
				has_province_modifier = eurow_concubine_12c
			}
			remove_province_modifier = eurow_concubine_12c
		}
		set_country_flag = cosmo_eurowives_in_capital
		random_province = {
			limit = {
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
				culture = venetian
			}
				save_event_target_as = consortprovince
		}
		random_province = {
			limit = {
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
				culture = venetian
				development = 9
			}
				save_event_target_as = consortprovince
		}
		random_province = {
			limit = {
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
				culture = venetian
				development = 15
			}
				save_event_target_as = consortprovince
		}
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_forbiddenpalace
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_harem
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_ooku
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}		
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_nobleaffairs
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_wives
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}		
			event_target:consortprovince = {
			add_province_modifier = { 
				name = cosmo_has_consort_present
				duration =  -1
				hidden = yes
				}				
			add_province_modifier = { 
				name = eurow_concubine_12c
				duration =  -1
				desc = eurow_concubine_12c_DESC
				}			
			}																													
		}
	}	
	
	option = {
		name = cosmo_eurowivesestate_events.1023.a

			NOT = {
				has_estate = estate_nobleaffairs
			}

				OR = {
				primary_culture = venetian
				}
					cosmo_asian_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
			event_target:consortprovince = {
				owned_by = ROOT		
			}
		}	
		event_target:consortprovince = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = "domain_of_spouses_family"
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {

			NOT = {

			}	
			}
		}

#grant wives 13c
country_event = {
	id = cosmo_eurowivesestate_events.1033
	title = cosmo_eurowivesestate_events.1033.t
	desc = cosmo_eurowivesestate_events.1033.d
	picture = cosmogfx_WIVES_EUROPE_MENU_13C_1_eventPicture
	goto = consortprovince

	is_triggered_only = yes

	trigger = {
		ai = no
		OR = {
			has_estate = estate_forbiddenpalace 
			has_estate = estate_harem 
			has_estate = estate_ooku 
			has_estate = estate_wives 
			has_estate = estate_nobleaffairs
			has_estate = estate_harem 
		}
		NOT = {
		any_province = {
			country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
				has_province_modifier = eurow_concubine_13c
		}
		}
		
		OR = {
			development_in_provinces = {
				value = 3
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
			OR = {
				culture = umbrian
			}
			}
			any_subject_country = {
			development_in_provinces = {
				value = 3
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
			OR = {
				culture = umbrian
			}
			}				
			}			
				OR = {
				primary_culture = umbrian
				}
		}
			
	}



	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
		every_province = {
			limit = {
				has_province_modifier = eurow_concubine_13c
			}
			remove_province_modifier = eurow_concubine_13c
		}
		set_country_flag = cosmo_eurowives_in_capital
		random_province = {
			limit = {
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
				culture = umbrian
			}
				save_event_target_as = consortprovince
		}
		random_province = {
			limit = {
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
				culture = umbrian
				development = 9
			}
				save_event_target_as = consortprovince
		}
		random_province = {
			limit = {
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
				culture = umbrian
				development = 15
			}
				save_event_target_as = consortprovince
		}
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_forbiddenpalace
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_harem
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_ooku
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}		
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_nobleaffairs
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}
		add_estate_influence_modifier = {
			estate = estate_wives
			desc = EST_VAL_NEW_CONUBINE_EUROPE
			influence = -10
			duration = 3650
		}		
			event_target:consortprovince = {
			add_province_modifier = { 
				name = cosmo_has_consort_present
				duration =  -1
				hidden = yes
				}				
			add_province_modifier = { 
				name = eurow_concubine_13c
				duration =  -1
				desc = eurow_concubine_13c_DESC
				}			
			}																													
		}
	}

					cosmo_asian_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes

		}

				value = 3
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT

		}
